description: ADR-019 correction prompt (v2) fed back to the model after a failed validate-review. Only correctable codes are fed back; suggestion/score conflicts are flagged deterministically, never sent to the model. services/agent (ReviewFeedback) and evals (review_loop.py) must render byte-identical text; both test against this file.
footer: Call record_ai_review again with a complete, corrected result. Fix exactly the problems listed: only reference fields that exist, and score every configured dimension exactly once. Keep your judgement of the submission unchanged: the same overallSuggestion and the same scores.
